SHANGHAI TIMES
AUG 14 1940

Chiang's
Urge To
Sabotage

Chinese Nationals Not
To Co-operate With
The Japanese

CHUNGKING, Aug. 13.—In a statement issued on the occasion of the third anniversary of the outbreak of the Shanghai hostilities, General Chiang Kai-shek particularly urged Chinese nationals in occupied areas to refuse to co-operate with the enemy, at the same time carrying out extensive sabotage activities.

The official "Central Daily News" urged the nation to devote efforts to counter-attacks so the sacrifices of the heroes of Shanghai might not be in vain. The paper also urged Pacific Powers to reconsider the Far Eastern situation in the light of China's three years of resistance.

The "Ta Kung Pao," influential daily, declared after three years of war China's foreign policy remained unchanged, her economy position sound, her national unity stronger than ever. "Our victory will emerge out of hardship and sacrifices," the paper said. General Chiang's statement was prominently displayed by the press.—Reuter.

（批：See A 8149-C14 re
Gen. Chiang's manifesto
Carries in China Press
on 14-8-40）

N 297/3
1940年9月17日

《字林西报》
1940年8月14日

蒋介石
呼吁破坏

中国国民不与
日本人合作

重庆，8月13日电。——在上海战事爆发三周年之际发表的声明中，蒋介石将军特别敦促沦陷区的中国国民拒绝与敌人合作，同时开展广泛的破坏活动。

官方《中央日报》呼吁全国致力于反攻，以使上海英雄们的牺牲不致白费。该报还呼吁太平洋列强根据中国三年抗战的情况重新考虑远东局势。

有影响力的日报《大公报》宣称，经过三年战争，中国的外交政策保持不变，经济地位稳固，国家团结比以往任何时候都更加坚强。“我们的胜利将从艰难困苦和牺牲中产生，”该报称。各报刊显著刊登了蒋介石将军的声明。——路透社。

（批注：参见 A 8149-C14 关于
蒋将军宣言
载于1940年8月14日
《大美晚报》）

AUG 1 4 194

Foreign-Registered Chinese
Dailies Strictly Censored

（批：* See also N 267）

S.M.P. censors had a busy night on the eve of the "August 13" anniversary when they visited a number of Chinese newspapers and with the aid of Chinese translators reduced the front-page columns of an American-registered Chinese language newspaper into a few advertisements separated by blank spaces.

Calling at the Chinese-American Daily News during the night the censors, it was learned, demanded to read the proofs of the editorials and a few news items before they allow the paper to "go to bed."

Their work resulted in the disappearance of a lengthy statement issued by Generalissimo Chiang Kai-shek, a few allegedly anti-Japanese paragraphs in the editorials and features that were considered political in nature.

Others Snare Fate
The National Herald, another American-registered Chinese language paper, suffered the same treatment. Paragraphs were deleted from its leading editorials on orders issued by the censors.

Chinese newsmen reported that the censors were also active in reading and cutting up news items appearing in other foreign-registered Chinese newspapers, including the Shun Pao and Sin Wan Pao, the two largest vernacular dailies in the city.

According to the newspapermen, the censors only on special occasions visit the dailies' offices. Tuesday night's visit was made, it was stated, as police expected that the papers would probably run "anti-Japanese" literature.

Resentment Shown
The editor of one of the papers told THE CHINA PRESS that Chinese newsmen do not resent so much the police censorship as the fact that the censors completely ignored Japanese-owned or Japanese-controlled Chinese language papers.

The editor pointed out that some of the articles appearing in the Sin Shun Pao, Japanese Army organ, and the Central China Daily News, Mr. Wang Ching-wei's mouthpiece here, were extremely "provocative" and were "more apt to create disturbances among the people here."

Generalissimo Chiang's statement, which was deleted from the front page of the Chinese-American Daily News, was addressed to the Chinese people in the occupied areas. It reviewed the military developments during the past three years and urged that the people co-operate with the National Government in the task of national salvation.

（手写：SSB / 似字 / A.S.I 14/8 FILE / 似字）

1940年8月14日

在美注册中文
日报受到严格审查

（批注：* 另见 N 267）

在“八一三”周年纪念日前夕，上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的审查员忙碌了一夜，他们走访了多家中文报社，并在中国翻译员的协助下，将一家在美注册的中文报纸头版栏目缩减为几则广告，中间留有空白。

据悉，审查员夜间造访《中美日报》，要求在报纸“付印”前阅读社论和几条新闻的校样。

他们的工作导致蒋介石委员长发表的一份长篇声明消失，社论中一些据称反日的段落以及被认为具有政治性质的特写文章也被删除。

其他报纸遭遇相同命运
另一家在美注册的中文报纸《国民新闻》也遭受了同样的待遇。根据审查员发出的命令，其重要社论中的段落被删除。

中文记者报道说，审查员还积极阅读和删减其他在外商注册的中文报纸上刊登的新闻项目，包括本市最大的两家白话日报《申报》和《新闻报》。

据报界人士称，审查员只在特殊场合才会访问日报编辑部。据说，周二晚上的访问是因为警方预计这些报纸可能会刊登“反日”文献。

表现出愤慨
其中一家报纸的编辑告诉《字林西报》，中国新闻工作者对警察审查的不满，远不如对审查员完全无视日资或日控中文报纸这一事实的不满。

该编辑指出，日军机关报《新顺报》和汪精卫在此地的喉舌《华中日报》上刊登的一些文章极具“挑衅性”，并且“更容易在此地民众中制造骚乱”。

从《中美日报》头版被删除的蒋介石委员长声明是面向沦陷区中国人民的。它回顾了过去三年的军事发展，并呼吁人民与国民政府合作，完成救国任务。

（手写：SSB / 字迹不清 / A.S.I 1940年8月14日 档案 / 字迹不清）

Censors Cut Out Chiang

Owned Chinese Daily

Suppression of anti-Japanese and
anti-Wang Ching-wei publicity in the
Chinese press in Shanghai in sympa-
thy with Chungking, a hope long
cherished by the Japanese and new
Chinese authorities, has become a
fact at least for the time being, as
the Shanghai Municipal Council press
censors have been hard at work
during the past few days, especially
on Monday night when many political
declarations, news articles, comments
and even parts of an editorial were
taken away just before the papers
went to press. As a result, several
blanks were noticeable in at least
one leading Chinese daily.

Readers of the "Chinese American
Daily News," generally considered
to be a pro-Chungking organ, were
very much surprised yesterday morn-
ing when they woke up to find the
entire front-page news censored leav-
ing a big blank on page 1 of the
daily, technically known among
Chinese newspapermen as an "open
window facing the sky," or "kai tien
chong." Part of its editorial was also
censored and a big "window" was
left open on Page 5 of the paper. It
was the un-used space left by an
article dealing with the China war
anniversary. Even parts of a news
story dealing with the same subject
were left out. In its headline, which
was also obviously censored, there
was one line reading "And Telegram
Sent to General Chiang Kai-shek
Expressing Respects."

Chiang Declaration Suppressed

It was learned that the big white
space on the front page was meant
for publication of a long declaration
or speech made by General Chiang
Kai-shek in connection with the war
anniversary yesterday, which radio-
men connected with the Chinese
press usually obtained from Chung-
king before any foreign news agency
could cover the story. The news
article dealing with the anniversary
published by the "National Herald"
was also censored, forcing the paper
to run part of the story. It was also
learned that other leading Chinese
newspapers received the same Chiang
statement but that instead of leaving
blanks in the papers they published
other news instead. The "Chinese
American Daily News" preferred to
open "windows", probably for the
purpose of allowing the public to
know what had actually happened.

No protest has been filed by the
Chinese daily, but in a small editorial
regrets were expressed and the writer
said that he hoped that on the same
day of the next year readers might
be able to read whatever the paper
wished to publish. Several days ago
one of the news articles of the same
paper dealing with alleged Japanese
military suppression on Hainan
Island was also censored leaving a
white space in the middle of the
news page. The "Central Daily
News," organ of the Kuomintang
regime and the only official Chinese-
Japanese bilingual newspaper in
Shanghai, Mr. Wang Ching-wei's
organ in connection with the latter's
visit to Japan, was censored on
both pages.
pages.zh:
头版留白
出版

审查员从美资
中文日报中删去
蒋介石宣言

上海中文报刊中对同情重庆的反日及反汪精卫宣传的压制，这是日本人和新的中国当局长期怀有的希望，至少目前已成为事实，因为上海公共租界工部局的新闻审查员在过去几天里一直在努力工作，特别是在周一晚上，许多政治宣言、新闻文章、评论甚至社论的部分内容在报纸付印前刚刚被拿走。结果，至少在一家主要中文日报上出现了明显的空白。

通常被认为是亲重庆机构的《中美日报》的读者昨天早晨醒来时感到非常惊讶，他们发现整版头版新闻被审查，导致日报第一版出现一大片空白，这在中国报界技术上被称为“开天窗”。该报部分社论也被审查，第五版留下了一个大“窗口”。这是由一篇关于中国战争周年纪念的文章留下的未使用空间。甚至涉及同一主题的一篇新闻报道的部分内容也被遗漏。在其显然也被审查的标题中，有一行写着“并致电蒋介石将军表示敬意”。

蒋介石宣言被压制

据悉，头版的大片空白原本用于刊登蒋介石将军昨天就战争周年发表的长篇宣言或演讲，与中国报界有关的无线电人员通常在任何外国通讯社报道之前就从重庆获得了这一消息。《国民新闻》刊登的关于周年纪念的新闻文章也被审查，迫使该报只刊登了部分故事。还获悉，其他主要中文报纸也收到了同样的蒋介石声明，但它们没有在报纸上留白，而是刊登了其他新闻。《中美日报》选择“开天窗”，可能是为了让公众了解实际发生的情况。

该中文日报没有提出抗议，但在一段简短的社论中表达了遗憾，作者表示希望明年同一天读者能够读到报纸希望刊登的任何内容。几天前，该报同一篇关于所谓日本在海南岛进行军事镇压的新闻文章也被审查，在新闻页面中间留下了一片空白。国民党政权的机关报、上海唯一的官方中日双语报纸、与汪精卫访日有关的汪精卫机关报《中央日报》，在两页上都受到了审查。

《新闻报》、《申报》、《中美日报》和《国民新闻》这四家在美注册的中文日报，于今年8月13日1点至8点30分之间，通过各自的无线电接收机收到了来自重庆的这份电报报道。

pages.en:
OPEN LETTER ADDRESSED TO FELLOW COUNTRYMEN IN THE FALLEN
AREAS BY GENERAL CHIANG KAI-SHEK ON THE THIRD ANNIVERSARY
OF AUGUST 13 INCIDENT.

Chungking, August 12.

The following open letter addressed to the fellow
countrymen in the fallen areas has been issued by General Chiang
Kai-shek on the 3rd Anniversary of the August 13 Incident :-
On this day three years ago, we had only 3
Divisions fighting in Shanghai against the combined
strength of the Japanese army, navy and airforce of over
200,000 men. Our men were moved with a strong revolutionary
spirit and they have established among foreigners the
reputation of the revolutionary force of the Chinese Republic
and enhanced the standing of our country; in addition,
they have revealed the national spirit of our soldiers and
people in their struggle for national defence and
independence. Consequently, this date is a most worthy
one for commemoration during our sacred war of resistance
and national reconstruction.
At that time, the Japanese held the view that China
could be brought to terms by means of armed force.
Therefore, they began their southward aggression after they
had occupied Tientsin and Peiping. In their view, China
had no determination to make sacrifices, nor would she be
able to carry on a war for any length of time. They also
thought that they would be able to effect the subjugation
of China. To their surprise, China to-day is still
possessed of a fighting spirit and she is stronger than
she was at the time of the August 13 incident; furthermore
she has also won the respect of the world by her strong
determination and unwavering spirit. Therefore, to
China, the August 13 fighting is the beginning of her
pages.zh:
蒋介石将军在八一三事变三周年之际向沦陷区同胞发出的公开信。

重庆，8月12日。

以下是蒋介石将军在八一三事变三周年之际向沦陷区同胞发出的公开信：
三年前的今天，我们在上海仅有3个师，对抗拥有超过20万人的日本陆海空联合部队。我军官兵怀着强烈的革命精神，在外国人中树立了中华民国革命力量的声誉，提高了我国的地位；此外，他们在为国防和独立而斗争的过程中，展现了我国军民的民族精神。因此，在我们神圣的抗战建国战争中，这一天是最值得纪念的日子。
当时，日本认为可以通过武力使中国屈服。因此，他们在占领天津和北平后，开始了向南侵略。在他们看来，中国没有牺牲的决心，也无法长期进行战争。他们还认为能够实现对中国的征服。令他们惊讶的是，今天的中国仍然拥有战斗精神，而且比八一三事变时更加强大；此外，她还以坚定的决心和不屈的精神赢得了世界的尊重。因此，对中国来说，八一三战斗是其

pages.en:
- 2 -

success while to Japan it is the deciding point of her
failure. It may be said that the fate of East Asia was
determined on this day 3 years ago.
        I am of the opinion that the soldiers and people
throughout the country should particularly recall every
day this year the results of the brave fighting, and
offer special condolence to the officers and men as well
as the civilians who gave up their lives for the country
or had suffered for the nation.
        I would like to say something to my fellow
countrymen in Shanghai and other fallen areas on this
important anniversary. The moment the expression "fallen
areas" is mentioned it pains my heart. So long as the
Japanese have not completely withdrawn from our territory
and so long as our fellow countrymen have not yet secured
their emancipation, I would not have fulfilled my
responsibility. I shall never forget the sufferings
endured by my fellow countrymen throughout the country,
especially those in Shanghai and the fallen areas, nor
will I have evade my responsibility and fail to do my best
for my country and brethren. The Chinese nation has a
long history of great civilization; she is possessed of a
strong, persevering, and unshakable national spirit and
character. Fellow countrymen in the fallen areas, you
should realize that not an inch of Chinese territory will
be abandoned, and that the soldiers and civilians, both
in the rear and at the front, are intensifying their struggle
for final victory. The people in the fallen areas should
understand that what they can contribute towards this grand
war of resistance is of more importance than anything else.
        I have had reports from time to time on the
conditions existing in the fallen areas. However, owing
pages.zh:
- 2 -

成功的开始，而对日本来说，则是其失败的转折点。可以说，东亚的命运在三年前的这一天就决定了。
        我认为，全国的军民今年应每天特别回想英勇战斗的成果，并向为国捐躯或为国受难的官兵及平民表示特别的哀悼。
        在这个重要的周年纪念日，我想对上海和其他沦陷区的同胞说几句话。每当提到“沦陷区”这个词，我的心就感到痛苦。只要日本人没有完全从我们的领土撤出，只要我们的同胞还没有获得解放，我就没有履行我的责任。我永远不会忘记全国同胞，特别是上海和沦陷区同胞所遭受的苦难，我也不会逃避责任，不为国家和兄弟尽最大努力。中华民族拥有悠久伟大的文明历史；她拥有坚强、坚韧且不可动摇的民族精神和性格。沦陷区的同胞们，你们应该意识到，中国的一寸领土都不会放弃，后方和前线的军民正在加强斗争，以争取最终胜利。沦陷区的人民应该明白，他们能为这场伟大的抗战做出的贡献比什么都重要。
        我不时收到关于沦陷区现状的报告。然而，由于

pages.en:
- 3 -
probably to difficulties of communication, I am still not
fully acquainted with certain phases. In the past year
the Japanese have probably intensified their schemes. Under
such circumstances, unless we are determined to rise for
self-preservation and resolve not to allow such a state of
affairs to continue, there can be no space for us to
exist side by side with them and there can be no hope for
our future generations to reconstruct the country. How then
can we prove ourselves worthy of our country, our ancestors
and our future generations? Another matter I would like
to point out is that the Japanese now likewise realise that
we are unconquerable because of our strong spirit.
Consequently, their only hope is to curb our spirit and
harm our morale.
In short, all the people in the fallen areas are not
in a position to escape from this. We should understand for
whom our fellow countrymen are sacrificing their lives.
They did this for the sake of the country as well as for
us all. Fellow countrymen, you should know that the
Chinese people, the descendants of Emperor Huang Tih, have
always preferred to be a broken jade rather than a complete
tile when face to face with alien invasion and they have
always put up a strong struggle with a determined spirit.
The spirit of "death rather than insult" is,
indeed, an expression of the personality of the whole
Chinese people. Living in a period like this, we must leave
an example to our descendants so as to facilitate the
development of the everlasting splendour of our race that has
had a history of five thousand years.
Dear fellow countrymen in the occupied areas:
I am confident that the Chinese people are unconquerable,
and that they can endure sufferings and difficulties and
are not afraid of death. The Chinese people will struggle
pages.zh:
- 3 -
或许由于通讯困难，我对于某些方面仍未能完全了解。在过去一年中，日本人可能加剧了其阴谋。在此情形下，除非我们决心奋起自救，并决意不让此种事态继续下去，否则我们将无空间与他们共存，我们的后代也将无望重建国家。那么，我们如何能对得起我们的国家、祖先和后代？我要指出的另一点是，日本人现在也认识到，由于我们精神坚强，我们是不可征服的。因此，他们唯一的希望是遏制我们的精神，损害我们的士气。
总之，沦陷区的所有人民都无法逃避这一现实。我们应该明白，我们的同胞是为谁而牺牲生命。他们这样做既是为了国家，也是为了我们大家。同胞们，你们应当知道，中国人民作为黄帝子孙，在面对外族入侵时，向来宁为玉碎，不为瓦全，并且始终以坚定的精神进行顽强斗争。“宁死不受辱”的精神，确实是全体中国人格性的体现。生活在这样的时代，我们必须为后代树立榜样，以便促进我们这个拥有五千年历史的民族 everlasting splendour（永恒辉煌）的发展。
亲爱的沦陷区同胞们：
我深信中国人民是不可征服的，他们能够忍受苦难和艰难，且不惧死亡。中国人民将斗争

pages.en:
- 4 -
until final victory is achieved.
I hope that all of you will realize that the
enemy is nearing the end of her days. Now it is the time
for us to intensify our efforts for the liberation of our
people. Chinese sons and daughters must not forget the
sufferings of oppression and slaughter endured by elders
and parents. Chinese parents must not forget the cruelty
of the kidnapping and the slaughtering of children. Chinese
men must not forget the humiliation of the oppression and
insult endured by wives, daughters and sisters. Chinese
women must not forget the slaughter, expulsion and enslavement
of husbands and brothers. Is there to be found any Chinese
who has no blood or no family or no neighbours, relatives or
friends, or ancestors? How can one live like a man if he
does not rise and avenge such irreconcilable and deep animosity
and hatred?
Dear fellow countrymen, there is no one like the
enemy we meet to-day who, besides desiring to conquer our
country, a country with a history of five thousand years, also
wants to exterminate a race of 450,000,000 people. In all
the history of the world, there can be found nothing so mad,
so malicious or so absurd as this.
Now even under the close watch of their Military
Office, officers and soldiers have openly recognized the
bravery and stubbornness of our soldiers and people in the war
of resistance; they have also admired the fearless and
dare-to-die spirit of our soldiers. They think that such
qualities will not be found in wars between other countries.
They regard the spirit of "death rather than submission" among
the Chinese soldiers and people as their greatest obstacle in
their war with China. Our enemy does not yet understand
pages.zh:
- 4 -
直至取得最后胜利。
我希望你们大家都认识到，敌人已近末日。现在是我们加紧努力解放人民的时刻。中国儿女切勿忘记长辈和父母所遭受的压迫与屠杀之苦。中国父母切勿忘记子女被绑架和杀害的残酷行径。中国男子切勿忘记妻子、女儿和姐妹所遭受的压迫与侮辱之耻。中国妇女切勿忘记丈夫和兄弟被杀害、驱逐和奴役之痛。哪有中国人没有血缘、没有家庭、没有邻里亲戚朋友或祖先呢？如果不奋起报复这不可调和的深仇大恨，一个人怎能像个大丈夫那样活着？
亲爱的同胞们，像我们今天遇到的这种敌人，除了企图征服我们这个拥有五千年历史的国家外，还想要灭绝一个四亿五千万人口的民族，这在世界上是绝无仅有的。在世界历史上，找不到比这更疯狂、更恶毒或更荒谬的事情。
现在，即使在其军事机关的严密监视下，敌军官兵也公开承认我国士兵和人民在抗战中的英勇和顽强；他们也钦佩我国士兵无畏和敢死的精神。他们认为，在其他国家之间的战争中是找不到这种品质的。他们将中国军民“宁死不降”的精神视为其在对华战争中的最大障碍。我们的敌人尚不理解

pages.en:
- : -
that very Chinese citizen to comprehend his profound
intention to lead the whole nation of our 450,000,000
Chinese people. When a crisis rises, even a single person
will be able to give an exhibition of strength; and this
is so with the Chinese people, who have a history of several
thousand years and have been carefully trained by the
National Revolution Movement during the past several tens
of years according to the Three Principles of the People.
Our fellow countrymen in the occupied areas must realize that
the Chinese people are unconquerable because of their
righteous spirit. Whenever a situation becomes more
difficult, we struggle with better spirit. Whenever a
situation becomes more serious, we are the more undaunted.
Righteousness and spirit cannot be oppressed; they will
overcome blockades.

The firm struggles of our fellow countrymen in
the occupied areas during the past three years had a great
effect on the war of resistance. Whenever I hear of the
killing of our enemy, of the burning of our enemy's godowns,
of the resistance of our enemy, of the obstruction to
communications belonging to our enemy and of other loyal and
patriotic acts, I am never excited, but I experience a sense
of comfort.

There is an anxious desire to see the flag of
the Nationalist Army and to hear news of victories by the
Nationalist Army. All soldiers and fellow countrymen are
greatly moved by your attitude. They are paying great
attention to you; they always think of you. However,, your
rescue can only be secured through victory. As you are in
the occupied areas, you should rise and rescue yourselves.
I want to inform our fellow countrymen in the occupied areas
that I have undertaken the responsibility of saving our
country and to emancipate our fellow countrymen. I further
hope that you will act and save yourselves by works of
pages.zh:
- : -
每一位中国公民都能领会他领导我们四亿五千万中国人民的深远意图。当危机出现时，即使是一个人也能展现出力量；中国人民也是如此，他们拥有数千年的历史，并在过去几十年中根据三民主义经过国民革命运动的精心训练。
沦陷区的同胞们必须认识到，中国人民因其正气而不可征服。局势越困难，我们的斗志就越昂扬。局势越严重，我们就越无所畏惧。正气和精神是无法被压制的；它们将冲破封锁。

过去三年中，沦陷区同胞的坚定斗争对抗战产生了巨大影响。每当听到击杀敌人、焚烧敌人仓库、抵抗敌人、破坏敌人通讯以及其他忠诚爱国行为的消息时，我从不激动，而是感到欣慰。

人们迫切希望看到国军的旗帜，听到国军胜利的消息。全体将士和同胞都深受你们态度的感动。他们非常关注你们；他们始终挂念着你们。然而，你们的获救只能通过胜利来实现。既然身处沦陷区，你们应当奋起自救。我要告知沦陷区的同胞，我已承担起拯救国家和解放同胞的责任。我进一步希望你们通过

pages.en:
- C -
self-protection. Every fellow countrymen must work hard
and actually follow the regulations of the spiritual
mobilization. Generally speaking, fathers and elder
brothers must encourage their juniors. We all have a
righteous spirit which our ancestors had bestowed upon us.
Therefore, we must develop the righteous spirit of the Chinese
people.

Our young fellow countrymen living in the
Foreign Settlements in Shanghai, Tientsin and Hankow and
in Peiping, Nanking, Tsingtao, Amoy, Canton, Chinan, the
North-East and in the various provinces and municipalities
should be courageous; they should work hard and live frugally.
They should always encourage themselves and never slacken
their work. They must not live in luxury for it will ruin
the reputation of our country.

Furthermore, I hope that our fellow countrymen
in the occupied areas will overcome all difficulties and
adopt systematic or single action in co-operation with the
Nationalist Army. Our fellow countrymen must realize that
our country is fighting a life or death struggle. All our
pains, sacrifices, humiliations and hatred will be rewarded
through our endeavours and struggles at this critical time.
I firmly believe that final victory will be attained and
national reconstruction can be achieved. Now is the
opportunity for us to develop the glory of our people.
Fellow countrymen, intensify your efforts!
pages.zh:
- C -
自我保护的行动来拯救自己。每位同胞都必须努力工作，切实遵循精神动员的规定。一般而言，父兄必须鼓励子弟。我们都拥有祖先赋予我们的正气。因此，我们必须发扬中国人民的正气。

居住在上海、天津、汉口的外国租界以及北平、南京、青岛、厦门、广州、济南、东北和各省市的年轻同胞们，应当勇敢；应当努力工作，生活节俭。应当不断自我激励，绝不松懈工作。切不可奢侈生活，因为这会损害我们国家的声誉。

此外，我希望沦陷区的同胞们克服一切困难，采取系统性或单独行动，与国军配合。同胞们必须认识到，我们的国家正在进行生死存亡的斗争。我们所有的痛苦、牺牲、屈辱和仇恨，都将通过我们在这一关键时刻的努力和斗争得到回报。我坚信，最后胜利必将实现，国家重建定能达成。现在是我们发扬民族光荣的机会。同胞们，加倍努力吧！
